title: Espresso bar
desc: A modern Scandinavian espresso bar: pale oak slat cladding and white tiles, a big black-framed glass shopfront with a marble counter and coffee machine visible inside, a neon coffee-cup sign, a thin black metal roof edge, a polished concrete base, and a chalkboard menu painted by the door.

title: Pizzeria
desc: An Italian neighbourhood pizzeria: warm red brick walls, a green-white-red striped awning painted flat above the big ground-floor shop window, gold PIZZERIA lettering, the glow of a wood-fired oven seen through the glass, black-framed upstairs windows with flower boxes, a cream stone cornice and base, and a terracotta tile roof.

title: Retro diner
desc: A 1950s American roadside diner: polished stainless-steel ribbed walls with a red stripe band, a big red-and-chrome DINER sign over the double glass door, wide windows showing red booths and a counter inside, a black-and-white checkerboard base, and a red roof edge.

title: 24/7 convenience store
desc: A modern 24/7 convenience store: white and light-grey composite wall panels, a bright green and orange sign band reading 24/7 MART along the roof edge, a full glass storefront with shelves of snacks and drinks visible inside, offer posters in the windows, an ice freezer and a newspaper rack painted beside the sliding glass doors, and a grey concrete base.

title: Ramen shop
desc: A modern Japanese ramen shop: dark charred-wood walls with light cedar accents, a dark standing-seam metal roof, red paper lanterns and an indigo noren curtain painted over the sliding wooden door, a small sign with a steaming ramen bowl, and warm glowing windows with paper screens.

title: Ice cream parlour
desc: A cheerful modern ice cream parlour: pastel mint and pink painted wood panelling, a pink-and-white candy-striped awning painted flat above the windows, a big waffle-cone sign, crisp white trim, soft pink roof tiles, and a cream stone base.

title: Blacksmith's forge
desc: A medieval blacksmith's forge: rough grey fieldstone walls with dark oak timber beams, a sooty dark slate roof, a heavy stone foundation, a wide double plank door with iron straps, small shuttered windows, a horseshoe sign and soot stains around the openings.

title: Tudor inn
desc: A two-storey medieval Tudor inn: whitewashed plaster walls with a dense pattern of dark oak timber framing, weathered terracotta roof tiles, a grey stone foundation, an arched double oak door with a hanging inn sign painted beside it, small diamond-paned leaded windows with wooden shutters, and lanterns by the door.

title: Castle watchtower
desc: A medieval castle watchtower: big weathered grey castle stone blocks with moss in the joints, a flat roof of worn grey stone slabs, dark grey stone for the roof edge and the rough stone plinth, an iron-banded arched oak door, narrow arrow-slit windows, and a faded red heraldic banner painted on the front wall.

title: Corner café
desc: A modern two-storey corner café: smooth white render walls with warm vertical cedar wood panels, a flat roof with a thin dark grey metal edge, a polished concrete base, big black-framed glass doors, floor-to-ceiling black-framed windows, a minimalist café sign and small potted plants painted by the entrance.

title: Modern house
desc: A contemporary family house: charcoal fibre-cement walls mixed with light horizontal timber cladding, a standing-seam dark metal roof, a smooth concrete plinth, a tall wooden front door, large dark aluminium windows, and wall lights beside the door.

title: Sci-fi habitat
desc: A futuristic sci-fi habitat module: clean white composite hull panels with fine panel seams, cyan glowing light strips and small warning decals, a dark solar-panel roof, a graphite metal base with vents, a sliding airlock door with a glowing frame, and rounded tinted viewport windows.
